sloka: उषित्वा रजनीम् तत्र राजपुत्रावरिम्दमौ ।महर्षिमभिवाद्याथ जग्मतुस्तम् गिरिम् प्रति ॥२-५५-१॥
transliteration: uṣitvā rajanīm tatra rājaputrāvarimdamau ।maharṣimabhivādyātha jagmatustam girim prati ॥2-55-1॥

translations.english: After spending the night, the princes, destroyers of enemies, offered obeisance to that great sage (Bharadhwaja) and went towards that mount Chitrkuta.
